title: Masses in the box W = p⁻¹(C_s) ∩ q⁻¹(B) of S = [[G]] × S₀, A₁ = [[G ∖ Q_r]] × S₀ and A₂ = [[Q_r]] × S₀′
statement: Let P, k, m, n ∈ ℕ, let g = (g_1, …, g_k) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) be orthonormal with span G := span{g_1, …, g_k}, p := G.starProjection, q := G^⊥.starProjection, H^k := μHE[k], let 0 < r < s, Q_r := {t ∈ G : |⟨g_i, t⟩| ≤ r for all i}, C_s := {x ∈ ℝ^P : |⟨g_i, x⟩| < s for all i}, let B ⊆ ℝ^P be open and W := p⁻¹(C_s) ∩ q⁻¹(B). Let S, A₁, A₂ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be represented by IMReps R, R_{A₁}, R_{A₂} (IMRep univ n), and let R₀, R₀′ ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, m) have measures μ₀ := R₀.measure, μ₀′ := R₀′.measure carried by G^⊥ (μ₀(ℝ^P ∖ G^⊥) = 0 = μ₀′(ℝ^P ∖ G^⊥)). Assume, for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P (with A − t := (y ↦ t + y)⁻¹(A)): R.measure(A) = ∫_G μ₀(A − t) dH^k(t), R_{A₁}.measure(A) = ∫_{G∖Q_r} μ₀(A − t) dH^k(t) and R_{A₂}.measure(A) = ∫_{Q_r} μ₀′(A − t) dH^k(t) (lower Lebesgue integrals). Then M_W(S) = ofReal((2s)^k)·μ₀(B), M_W(A₁) = (ofReal((2s)^k) − ofReal((2r)^k))·μ₀(B) (truncated subtraction in [0, ∞]) and M_W(A₂) = ofReal((2r)^k)·μ₀′(B), where M_W = massOn W and ofReal = ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k m n : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (S A₁ A₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R RA₁ RA₂ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R₀ R₀' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (r s : ℝ) (B : Set (Euclid P)), Orthonormal ℝ g → 0 < r → r < s → IsOpen B → R.Represents S → RA₁.Represents A₁ → RA₂.Represents A₂ → R₀.measure ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → R₀'.measure ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∫⁻ t in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) : Set (Euclid P)), R₀.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[k]) → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → RA₁.measure A = ∫⁻ t in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) : Set (Euclid P)) \ {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, R₀.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[k]) → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → RA₂.measure A = ∫⁻ t in {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, R₀'.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[k]) → S.massOn ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * s) ^ k) * R₀.measure B ∧ A₁.massOn ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = (ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * s) ^ k) - ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k)) * R₀.measure B ∧ A₂.massOn ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k) * R₀'.measure B
